annotations.title: Resolve names to ids, find by meaning, list facets

description: Find the id of a brand, topic, market, question, page, site or place from its name, domain or URL. Up to 25 brand names, domains, URLs, topic, market or place names ("Austin, TX") or question wordings at once, each to its Parse id (brd_, top_, mkt_, plc_, qst_, pg_, site:): why each matched, its score, whether this workspace watches it (tracked), whether Parse has enough on a brand (indexed, thin, new, not_indexed); ambiguous lists companies sharing a name. kinds: ["facet"] (or "surface", "measure"): the dictionary of what filter.facet, filter.engine and query_metrics take, with definitions. Free.

kinds.description: what to match: brand, topic, question, market, page, site, place (default all); or facet, surface, measure alone for the dictionary; argument alone, with tool names in q: what a tool takes beyond its tools/list entry

match.description: name: exact names, domains and ids (the search by meaning needs sign-in)

q.description: names, domains, URLs, question wordings or typed ids; the dictionary takes words to look for, or none; kinds argument takes tool names

unit.description: dictionary only: facets of this unit (answer, mention, evidence, comparison, page, page_brand, question, topic_brand)

name: resolve_ids
